term: General-purpose AI model with systemic risk
plain: The EU AI Act's name for the most capable general models, which carry extra duties such as risk assessment and incident reporting.
eli5: The biggest, strongest robots get extra safety rules that the small ones don't.
technical: Under Article 51 of the EU AI Act, a general-purpose AI model with high-impact capabilities, presumed when cumulative training compute exceeds 10<sup>25</sup> FLOP or designated by the Commission; Article 55 sets its providers' obligations.
